# Khatib Designs

> Khatib Designs is an Arabic-first product and AI studio based in Kuwait, serving Kuwait, the UAE and the wider GCC. It designs and builds mobile apps, web platforms and AI systems — assistants, workflow automation and Arabic chatbots — for businesses. Founded in 2015, with 100+ products shipped across six countries.

- Book a free 30-minute get-to-know call: https://khatibdesigns.com/book/ (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/book/)
- Email: studio@khatibdesigns.com · WhatsApp: +965 5000 3048
- Founder: Nader Al-Khatib, enterprise AI consultant — https://khatibdesigns.com/nader/
- Every page exists in English and Arabic (Arabic under /ar/).

## AI consultancy (priced)

- [AI consultancy in Kuwait & the GCC](https://khatibdesigns.com/ai/): assess → build → support.
  - AI Readiness & Governance Sprint: KWD 3,500 fixed, 3 weeks — governance model, ranked roadmap and one working agent in production. A single-workflow version for smaller businesses: KWD 1,500.
  - The Build: from KWD 7,000, typically 6–12 weeks — multiple workflows in production, systems connected.
  - AI Operations: KWD 2,500/month — monitoring, tuning, new workflows and a monthly plain-language report.
- [AI for Dubai & the UAE](https://khatibdesigns.com/dubai/): Arabic-first AI for UAE businesses.
- [Product & app builds](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/): from KWD 3,000 — scope, timeline and a fixed price back within one business day, no discovery invoice.
- [Services](https://khatibdesigns.com/#services): iOS, Android and web products, UX/UI design, MVPs.

## Proof

Nine shipped case studies, with the region and sector each was built for.

- [Case studies](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/): the full set, Kuwait to the United States.
- [Safey](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/safey/) (Global · Privacy): a vault that fights back — an encrypted iOS vault with break-in alerts and a duress decoy passcode that opens an empty vault under pressure.
- [Spotly](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/spotly/) (Kuwait · Family): find the day out, keep the memory — bilingual family outing discovery for Kuwait, with places screened by AI and a merchant side for venues.
- [LUMA](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/luma/) (Global · Game): glow up, play on — a 40-level puzzle game shipped to both the App Store and Google Play, with boss fights and daily challenges.
- [DWA](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/dwa/) (Kuwait · Health): your pharmacy, delivered — prescriptions, chat with a pharmacist, and doorstep delivery, in Arabic and English.
- [PrintIt](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/printit/) (Kuwait · Marketplace): printing, delivered to your door — a print marketplace with instant quoting on a live map, so you upload, price and track without a single phone call.
- [iWASH](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/iwash/) (Kuwait · On-demand): book a wash, get on shining — on-demand car washing booked in seconds, with routing and scheduling built for Kuwait's traffic and heat.
- [Coines](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/coines/) (Bulgaria · Fintech): crypto exchange, simplified — a peer-to-peer exchange where you register, link a wallet and trade in minutes, with live status and in-app messaging.
- [Connect Here](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/connect-here/) (United States · Social): meet the people in the room — venue-based social networking that connects people inside the same place, in real time.
- [WCS](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/wcs/) (United States · Enterprise): run the factory floor — timesheets, wages and budgets for a working factory, an enterprise system people actually use every shift.

## How to engage

- Book a free 30-minute get-to-know call: https://khatibdesigns.com/book/ — in Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/book/
- Email studio@khatibdesigns.com with what you're building, your timeline and a budget range.
- WhatsApp +965 5000 3048.

## Not a fit

- No staffing or body-shop placement — we don't rent out developers by the seat.
- No ad-buying or media management.
- No reselling third-party SaaS licences.
- No selling you a model. We build the unglamorous plumbing around it, which is where these projects actually fail.
